QuestInfo.name: Dark Ringmaster
QuestInfo.0: You can talk to Grin's soul once you obtain his relic.
QuestInfo.1: Hold onto Grin's ordinary ring for 30 minutes to fill it with magic and receive his powerful ring.
QuestInfo.2: You filled Grin's ring up back with magic and got a far more powerful one.

0.0: Heyo, lookit that ring! That was mine, 'cause I'm Grin the clown! I do all kinds of dark magics to entertain my dark fans. Kids love it!
0.1: Can you charge that ring back up with dark powers? I can't even hold it, but I'd love to do some dark tricks for you.
0.2: Hold onto that ring for 30 minutes to fill it up with the dark stuff, and I will release its dark powers for YOU to play with!

yes.0: You'll be known all over as the ringmaster of darkness if you succeed! Darkness for everyone, yay!

no.0: Don't make me haunt you. Seriously, I'm no good at it.
